dataset: mHomeGes (Liu et al., 2020), continuous recordings segmented into 24,105 repetitions (see README)

LUO5.description: 5-fold leave-users-out (sklearn GroupKFold(5) grouped by user over our segmented sample order)

cross_distance.description: Train on all samples recorded at <=1.8 m, test on all samples at >=2.4 m; users overlap (distance shift only); 1.95-2.25 m unused
